scope: Actual VSIX dashboard assets in Chromium with mock Host and synthetic data; no VS Code or GitLab.
method: Fresh context per round. Search uses scripted DOM input to matching narrowed or restored visible rows and two animation frames; scroll uses the actual outer page scrollTop to two animation frames. Heap is shared renderer V8 heap after GC, not process memory. Runtime/CDP automation overhead and fixture scale are not production server measurements.
